name: Build: Surface detail: normal maps, decals and contact shadows
body: Texture and normal map support, decals, and a blob/contact shadow under the player. One PR based on nox-proto, with before/after screenshots, a guide page and a decision.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Blob shadows done (D-069): composite-pass ellipses from the depth buffer, lantern::graphics::AddBlobShadow, platformer player uses it in place of the disc, guide docs/blob-shadows.md. Normal maps and textured decals are still to do; this card stays open for them.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Blob shadows done in D-069 (#83). Normal maps done in D-072: Bumps texture, SetNormalMap, fourth sampler on the lit shader, guide docs/normal-maps.md. Projected decals not built (reason in D-072); a flat quad above the surface works for ground marks.
